name: Tarindrella
summary: In Shadowglen, Tarindrella watches over Teldrassil's sheltered woods. The dryad works with night elf protectors to investigate corruption among the World Tree's wildlife.

sections.title: A Daughter of Cenarius in Shadowglen
sections.body: Tarindrella dwells in Shadowglen, a protected glade atop Teldrassil. Dryads are fierce caretakers of nature, born of the demigod Cenarius. Many live deep in ancient Kalimdor forests such as Ashenvale, but Tarindrella watches over this young grove. She bridges the wild spirits and young night elf defenders taking their first steps beyond Aldrassil. Her chief concern is a taint creeping through the forest. She sends reliable adventurers to drive back local pests and gather clues to its source.

sections.title: Investigating Teldrassil's Affliction
sections.body: Teldrassil is the new crown of the night elf people, yet sickness has reached its groves. Furbolgs once lived peacefully in their homes; now they have gathered as the Gnarlpine tribe. Grells and grellkin tainted by wicked Fel Moss infest the hills around Shadowglen. Tarindrella suspects the moss is behind these changes. She directs initiates to confront the grells and bring back samples, hoping to halt the corruption before it overtakes the young grove.

faq.answer: In Shadowglen atop Teldrassil, Tarindrella aids night elves in watching the wilderness. The dryad directs young defenders against a strange sickness threatening the World Tree's boughs.
Dryads are woodland beings born of the demigod Cenarius. With the upper body of a night elf and the lower body of a fawn, they guard Kalimdor's sacred groves and their balance.

faq.q: Why is Tarindrella concerned about Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Unnatural corruption is twisting creatures around Shadowglen. Furbolgs have gathered as the hostile Gnarlpine tribe, and Fel Moss-tainted grells fill the hills. Tarindrella seeks to cleanse the taint and protect the young grove.

faq.q: What threats does she send adventurers to face?
faq.answer: Tarindrella sends adventurers to confront grells and grellkin in Shadowglen and gather the wicked Fel Moss they carry. She hopes to learn whether it lies behind the corruption.

angles.text: As a young night elf in Shadowglen, you may meet Tarindrella, a dryad who embodies the ancient covenant between the Kaldorei and the children of Cenarius.
As a druid, you regard dryads as kindred spirits of the wild. Tarindrella's guidance on Teldrassil's sickness calls you to help keep the balance.
